# Setup

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```

Load in results from Extinct and Extant simulations:

```{r load-results}
C1_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/C1/Extinct/initials.rds")
C2_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/C2/Extinct/initials.rds")
C3_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/C3/Extinct/initials.rds")
C4_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/C4/Extinct/initials.rds")

C1_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/C1/Extinct/thresholds.rds")
C2_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/C2/Extinct/thresholds.rds")
C3_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/C3/Extinct/thresholds.rds")
C4_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/C4/Extinct/thresholds.rds")
```

# Extinct Comparison

Compare C1 with C2, C3, and C4:

```{r extinct-comparison}
C12_initials <- left_join(C1_initials, C2_initials, by = "model") %>% 
  mutate(power_difference = power.y - power.x)
C13_initials <- left_join(C1_initials, C3_initials, by = "model") %>% 
  mutate(power_difference = power.y - power.x)
C14_initials <- left_join(C1_initials, C4_initials, by = "model") %>% 
  mutate(power_difference = power.y - power.x)

C12_thresholds <- left_join(C1_thresholds, C2_thresholds, by = "model") %>% 
  mutate(threshold_difference = threshold.y - threshold.x)
C13_thresholds <- left_join(C1_thresholds, C3_thresholds, by = "model") %>% 
  mutate(threshold_difference = threshold.y - threshold.x)
C14_thresholds <- left_join(C1_thresholds, C4_thresholds, by = "model") %>% 
  mutate(threshold_difference = threshold.y - threshold.x)

C12_comparison <- left_join(C12_initials, C12_thresholds, by = "model")
C13_comparison <- left_join(C13_initials, C13_thresholds, by = "model")
C14_comparison <- left_join(C14_initials, C14_thresholds, by = "model")

C12_plot <- ggplot(C12_comparison) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_difference, y = threshold_difference)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  expand_limits(y = -100) +
  labs(x = "Difference in Initial Power (at Time of Extinction)",
       y = "Difference in Time to Achieve 80% Power",
       subtitle = "C1 (Null) vs C2 (Declining Detectability)") +
  theme_classic()

C13_plot <- ggplot(C13_comparison) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_difference, y = threshold_difference)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  # expand_limits(y = -100) +
  labs(x = "Difference in Initial Power (at Time of Extinction)",
       y = "Difference in Time to Achieve 80% Power",
       subtitle = "C1 (Null) vs C3 (Increasing Survey Effort)") +
  theme_classic()

C14_plot <- ggplot(C14_comparison) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_difference, y = threshold_difference)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  expand_limits(y = -100) +
  labs(x = "Difference in Initial Power (at Time of Extinction)",
       y = "Difference in Time to Achieve 80% Power",
       subtitle = "C1 (Null) vs C4 (Combined)") +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r extinct-portrait}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 16
ggarrange(C12_plot, C13_plot, C14_plot, nrow = 3)
```

```{r extinct-landscape}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 8
ggarrange(C12_plot, C13_plot, C14_plot, ncol = 3)
```
